name: University of Manchester
overview: Large Russell Group university in north-west England with a broad research base across engineering, life sciences, business and the humanities. A common target for Bangladeshi applicants seeking a research-intensive UK master's outside London.

name: University of Leeds
overview: Russell Group university in Yorkshire with large engineering, computing and business faculties and an established international student community.

name: University of Sheffield
overview: Russell Group university known for engineering and materials research, situated in a city with notably lower living costs than southern England.

name: University of Glasgow
overview: One of the oldest universities in the English-speaking world, in Scotland. Scottish master's programmes and the post-study work route are frequent points of interest for South Asian applicants.

name: University of Greenwich
overview: London university with a large international intake and a strong presence of Bangladeshi students, particularly on business, computing and engineering master's programmes.

name: University of Portsmouth
overview: South-coast university with practical, industry-linked courses and living costs well below London. A regular choice for budget-conscious international applicants.

name: Coventry University
overview: Modern university with a very large international cohort, multiple January and May intakes, and a strong applied engineering and business portfolio.

name: Northumbria University
overview: Newcastle-based university with growing research strength and comparatively low living costs in the north-east of England.

name: Teesside University
overview: North-east England university with a long record of recruiting South Asian postgraduates onto computing, engineering and management programmes.

name: University of Bedfordshire
overview: Luton and Bedford campuses within commuting distance of London, with multiple intakes a year and a large international student population.

name: Texas Tech University
overview: Large public research university in west Texas with substantial graduate engineering and computer science enrolment and relatively modest living costs.

name: University of Houston
overview: Public research university in one of the largest US metropolitan areas, with strong energy, engineering and business links and extensive assistantship opportunities.

name: Wayne State University
overview: Urban public research university in Detroit with graduate programmes in engineering, computing and health sciences.

name: University of Memphis
overview: Tennessee public university with graduate computing, engineering and business programmes and comparatively low cost of attendance.

name: University of Toledo
overview: Ohio public university with engineering and pharmacy strengths and a long-standing international graduate intake.

name: Kent State University
overview: Ohio public university offering graduate programmes across computing, business and the sciences with moderate tuition for a US public institution.

name: Michigan Technological University
overview: Technology-focused public university in Michigan's Upper Peninsula, concentrated on engineering, computing and applied sciences.

name: New Mexico State University
overview: Land-grant public university with engineering and agricultural research and one of the lower costs of attendance among US public research universities.

name: Southern Illinois University Carbondale
overview: Illinois public research university with graduate engineering and computing programmes and a low cost of living relative to US metropolitan campuses.
